def: Banana, the name of four Israelite

occurrences.text: Baana the son of Ahilud; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth–shean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Beth–shean to Abel–meholah, even unto the place that is beyond Jokneam:
Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth:
